label: PHASE_O_SCENE_PRIOR_DECISION
question: Is COCO+spatial scene prior applicable?
rationale: COCO detects 0 persons at conf>=0.10 in GT frames (R360 representation)
At conf=0.001 (noise), persons appear at max_conf=0.022 — below any useful operating threshold
A scene-prior spatial filter requires first having a high-recall detector as input
With 0 persons at useful conf, no spatial filter can recover missing detections
Scene-prior approach not viable at R360 resolution
alternative_note: At 1080p, COCO may detect spectators at higher confidence. If Paris canary were processed at 1080p, scene-prior might be viable. However, the training corpus uses 360p proxy format. A mismatch between training and inference resolution would introduce additional domain shift.
